units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 37b:10">B. Kam. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>הך שופר קמא ס׳ בעלמא וכ׳</he> that first goring when the animal heard the sound of a trumpet, was merely due to the fright which seized it.
<cite ref="Yoma 22b:18">Yoma 22ᵇ</cite> <he>חזא ס׳ בחלמיה</he> saw a panic in his dream (frightening demons, Rashi); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 117:3">Yalk. Sam. 117</cite>.
